scripts.backup: [ -f rss.db ] && sqlite3 rss.db ".backup 'rss-$(($(ls rss-[0-9]*.rss 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*rss-\([0-9]*\)\.rss/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1) + 1)).rss'"
scripts.build:all: backup run backup && npm run build && cargo build --release
scripts.build:all:force: backup run backup && npm run build && cargo clean -p rustrsssrv && cargo build --release
